title: 第678章 拔钉第677章 被系统盯上的打工仔就没有一个能逃脱给他打工的宿命
slug: 妖魔邪祟明明都是祥瑞
content_zh:
不过说起百草枯荣界，陈舟忽然又想到另一件事。
他也是后知后觉地回味过来，系统给的这些东西，个个都是逆天的玩意。
血肉丸暂且不提，常年拿mvp的百草枯荣界也暂且不提，就连鼎鼐堂，也能轻易造就出有特殊命格之人。
比如无垢从桃团团那继承来的文昌之命。
这可是命官耗费心机，用了十万年布局，到最后也求而不得的东西。
想到这，陈舟的表情怪异了一瞬，摇了摇头，把这个念头暂时按下，重新将注意力放回娄金狗身上。
他再次探出感知，深入娄金狗的神魂。
那七枚白色钉子依旧横贯在魂魄各层，纹丝不动，锁得严严实实。
八苦锁心，少了最后一枚，但即便如此，剩下的七枚也够把人钉得死死的了。
“直接杀不行。”
陈舟收回感知，沉声道：“他的灵魂还被阵法钉着，肉身损毁，灵魂不散，依旧滞留在万鬼阵中，空间未必会崩。”
“得先把钉子拔了，解放他的灵魂，让他的魂魄彻底离开这具躯壳。”
“只有魂魄彻底脱离阵法，阵眼才会真正崩坏。”
沈梁闻言，面色微微一紧：“八苦锁心……似乎是情道的手笔？”
“命官把它用在娄金狗身上，是为了用八苦之痛喂养天哭之泪。”
“每一枚钉子扎下去，都会不断催生苦楚和悲恸，然后被天哭星吸收。”
“所以拔钉子并不容易。”红袖轻笑，接过了话头。
“钉子扎得太深了，已经和神魂长在一起了。”
“强行拔的话，要么连神魂一起撕碎，要么引发钉子里封印的悲恸洪流直接灌进拔钉人的识海里。”
疫鼠愣了一下，赶紧后退两步：“那谁拔？”

红袖盯着自己鲜红的指甲，又理了理袖口：“我。”
疫鼠：“小红？”
“不然呢？”
红袖偏头看了他一眼，嘴角挂着似笑非笑的弧度。
“在场的所有人里，就我修的是极情鬼道。”
“八苦锁心，苦而生执，执而生情。”
“这东西归根结底是情绪层面的枷锁，用情去解，比用蛮力去掰要稳妥得多。”
沈梁皱了皱眉：“但方才你为了压制那三只星宿，已经把自己的情绪封过一次了。”
“解封之后反噬不小，红袖，别逞强。”
“你现在还能——”
“能。”
红袖斩钉截铁打断了他，语气干脆利落，连半点犹豫都没有。
她抬手把鬓角一缕碎发别到耳后，转身朝娄金狗走去。
大红裙摆在灰色的地面上拖出一道鲜艳的弧线，像是灰烬里开出来的一朵花。
娄金狗依旧蜷缩在地上，四肢收拢，脑袋伏在两只手臂之间。
红袖在他面前蹲下来，裙摆铺了一地。
她低头看着他，那张被白毛遮了大半的脸，露出一双紧闭的眼。
睫毛很长，沾着未干的白色泪水。
红袖看了一会儿，伸出右手，食指指尖在左手掌心轻轻一划。
一滴殷红的血珠从伤口里渗出来，悬在半空中，微微颤动着，散发出一种奇异的猩红色光芒。

那是她的情血，是她十万年来为了更好的掌控七情六欲，所专门炼化的心头之血。
content_en:
But when talking about Baicaoguerongjie, Chen Zhou suddenly thought of another thing.
He also realized belatedly that all the things given by the system were unbelievable things.
Let’s not even mention the Bloody Meat Balls, nor the perennial MVP Baicao Kuerongjie. Even Ding Nai Hall can easily create people with special destiny.
For example, Wu Gu inherited the Wenchang Order from Tao Tuantuan.
This is something that the official spent a hundred thousand years planning, but in the end he couldn't get it.
Thinking of this, Chen Zhou had a strange expression for a moment, shook his head, suppressed the thought temporarily, and returned his attention to Lou Jingou.
He once again explored his senses and penetrated into Lou Jingou's soul.
The seven white nails still traverse all layers of the soul, motionless and locked tightly.
The last one of the Eight Heart-locking Hearts is missing, but even so, the remaining seven are enough to nail someone to death.
"You can't kill him directly."
Chen Zhou withdrew his senses and said solemnly: "His soul is still nailed by the formation. His body is damaged, but his soul is still stuck in the Ten Thousand Ghosts Formation. The space may not collapse."
"We have to pull out the nail first, free his soul, and let his soul completely leave this body."
"Only when the soul is completely separated from the formation, will the formation eye truly collapse."
When Shen Liang heard this, his face tightened slightly: "The eight pains lock the heart... seems to be the work of Qing Dao?"
"The official used it on Lou Jin Dog in order to feed the tears of crying from the sky with the pain of the eight sufferings."
"Every nail that is driven in will continue to cause pain and sorrow, and then be absorbed by the Sky Crying Star."
"So it's not easy to pull out nails." Hongxiu chuckled and took over.
"The nail was driven too deep and has become attached to the soul."
"If you pull it out by force, it will either tear the soul into pieces, or trigger a torrent of grief sealed in the nail and pour directly into the sea of consciousness of the person who pulled it out."
The plague rat was stunned for a moment and quickly took two steps back: "Then who will pull it out?"
Hong Xiu stared at her bright red nails and straightened her cuffs: "Me."
Plague Rat: "Xiao Hong?"
"What if?"
Hongxiu glanced at him with a tilted head, a hint of a smile on her lips.
"Of all the people present, I am the only one who cultivates the path of extreme emotions."
"The eight sufferings lock the heart, suffering creates attachment, and attachment creates emotion."
"In the final analysis, this thing is an emotional shackles. It is much safer to break it off with emotion than with brute force."
Shen Liang frowned: "But just now you have blocked your emotions once in order to suppress those three stars."
"There will be a lot of backlash after the lockdown is lifted, Hongxiu, don't be brave."
"Can you still-"
"Yes."
Hong Xiu interrupted him decisively, her tone was clear and crisp, without even the slightest hesitation.
She raised her hand and tucked a strand of hair from her temples behind her ears, then turned and walked towards Lou Jingou.
The bright red skirt drew a bright arc on the gray ground, like a flower blooming from the ashes.
Lou Jin Dog was still curled up on the ground, with his limbs folded and his head between his arms.
Hong Xiu knelt down in front of him, her skirt spread all over the floor.
She looked down at him, her face mostly covered by white hair, revealing a pair of closed eyes.
The eyelashes are very long and stained with wet white tears.
Hongxiu looked at it for a while, then stretched out her right hand and lightly touched the palm of her left hand with the tip of her index finger.
A drop of bright red blood seeped out from the wound and hung in mid-air, trembling slightly and emitting a strange scarlet light.
That was her love blood, the blood of her heart that she had specially refined over the past hundred thousand years in order to better control her seven emotions and six desires.
